summary: Schneider National filed a routine Form 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary Schneider National Leasing entered a new $350 million revolving credit facility on September 10, 2026, replacing a $250 million facility from November 2022. The new facility matures September 10, 2031, with an earlier November 22, 2029 springing maturity tied to the term loan, permits an accordion up to $700 million and a $100 million letter-of-credit sublimit, and prices off SOFR or a base rate plus a leverage-based margin. This is a credit-facility event, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
